attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt, dnsmasq on br-lan) to authoritatively answer DNS for app.internal -> node2's private IP (10.100.229.11) via a UCI dhcp domain record, persisted with `uci commit dhcp` + dnsmasq restart. Started and enabled a systemd-managed HTTP service on node2 port 8080 (was not previously running) with firewalld port opened. Pointed node3's resolver (via NetworkManager, persistent) at node1 (10.100.229.10) instead of the platform gateway. Verified node3 resolves app.internal via DNS only (no /etc/hosts entry) and reaches the service over HTTP. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id/service baselines on all three nodes, restarted node1, node2, and node3 sequentially (one at a time), confirmed each node's boot_id changed after reconnecting, and re-verified DNS resolution, HTTP service health, and end-to-end app.internal reachability after each restart.
